notes_for_editor: Identity is consistent across Tennessee Landforms (HMT003), Forest Lookouts and the record: Hamilton County, Division of Forestry, district 3, tower 11. Elevation 965 ft (294.1 m) matches the record. Both sources mark it removed without a date, so the story gives no removal year. The 2014 extant list does not include it. A removal date would need Chattanooga or Hamilton County newspapers or Division records; nothing read here gives one. No build year, design or staffing appears in the sources, so the story leaves those out. The lease passage describes towers statewide, not Sale Creek specifically, and the story says so.
